name: THE GRANARY
rule: VAMILY rules 416 (the big interiors: the tile stays a house), 461 (more boards), 451(a) (its ceiling at 10%), 59 (every tile its cost and its effect), 428, 441.
facts: Paolo 7/6/26 (engine/bohemia_overmap.js, THE GRANARY): 'the oldest building in the world, a dead grocery distribution center recommissioned. Harvest storage, seed stock, and the cold rooms double as the MEDICINE VAULT.' One cell by the rail; one of the legendary gear places (engine/bohemia_boardkinds.js, the plant family: 'guarded by up to sixty men').
The dead's own line for the kind (engine/bohemia_dead.js): 'guarded the grain to the end'.

A grocery distribution center is a hall of pallet racking in long rows with aisles between, dock doors along its side, forklifts, and its cold rooms: walk-in freezers and coolers behind insulated walls a foot thick, the refrigeration plant beside them. Grain keeps in sacks on pallets and in bins; seed in crates; medicine that must stay cold in the cold rooms while their power lasts.
On house tiles a run of racking, a bin, the vault's shelves and the refrigeration plant each hide a man; the cold rooms' melt water standing on the floor is Battle Brothers' swamp.
how_to_mod: A layout is 15 strings of 20 characters; every character is in 'legend'; every tile kind a legend entry names has its row in 'tiles' (its cost and its effect). A piece names the finished piece it is drawn as ('like') until this folder has its own art file (granary_art.json: floor lists and a kit, the garage's format). slices/bohemia_big_inside.js lays it; slices/fight_ground/insides.json lists the insides.
districts_why: The granary is its building: eight fights in ten at its cell are fought inside, in the grain hall or the cold rooms, by the cell's own dice; the rest at its docks outside.
tiles_how: Rule 59: every kind of tile says what it costs to step on and what it does. 'row' is the fight's own ground row (flat 2 AP, rough 3, height +1 a level, obstacles none); 'open' is open floor (on AUTO nobody stays on it); 'good' is ground AUTO goes to; 'say' is the one line he reads when he taps it (draft, the fewest words); 'sight' says whether a blocker hides a man ('blocked', the obstacles row) or is seen past ('seen'). [bb] each kind is a Battle Brothers ground: flat, rough, an obstacle, and cover as its trees and walls give it.

wall.effect: The distribution center's tilt-up wall: no way through, no sight through.

floor.effect: The hall's sealed concrete, swept: open ground, nothing to hide behind; on AUTO nobody stays on it.

racking.effect: A run of pallet racking four levels high, loaded with the harvest: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it; cover beside it. [bb] its wall.

sacks.effect: Grain in sacks, stacked on a pallet higher than a man: cover.

bin.effect: A steel grain bin bolted to the floor: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it. [bb] its boulder.

seed.effect: The seed stock in its crates, the next year's planting: cover.

forklift.effect: A forklift parked with its forks down: cover.

spill.effect: A sack split open, grain deep across the floor, a man wades it: slow going (3 AP), low cover. [bb] its brush.
spill.say: Spilled grain: slow going, low cover.

sandbags.effect: The guards' sandbags across an aisle: low cover. [bb] its palisade waist high.

camp.effect: The guards' camp in the aisle, cots and a stove and a rifle rack: they guarded the grain to the end: cover.

vault.effect: The medicine vault's shelves in the cold room, what is left of the valley's medicine: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it. [bb] its wall.

coldwall.effect: A cold room's insulated wall, a foot of foam in steel skin: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it. [bb] its wall.

carts.effect: Steel carts of boxed medicine and coolers: low cover.

plant.effect: The refrigeration plant, compressors on a skid, still running when the batteries hold: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it; cover beside it. [bb] its boulder.

counter.effect: The dispensing counter where the vault hands out what it hands out: cover.

melt.effect: The cold rooms dying, their frost melted into the floor and standing: slow going (4 AP), and a man standing in it fights worse. [bb] its swamp.
melt.say: Standing water: slow going, and you fight worse in it.

fire.effect: A fire somebody keeps in a drum. It burns day and night: a man in its light is seen.
fire.say_lit: A fire: you stand in its light, and they see you.

doors.effect: The dock doors, rolled up onto the yard: open ground, and by day the light falls in: a man here is seen.
doors.say_lit: The doors: open ground, and the day is on you.

kit_how: Every piece is drawn AS a finished piece of another kit ('like') until COOK's own picture for it is in granary_art.json under the same name: then that picture is used and nothing here changes. 'kind' is what it does in the fight (COVER, LOW_COVER, WALL); 'blocks_move' means nobody stands on its tile.
start_why: NO HIGH GROUND: the racking's top shelf is a climb nobody makes under fire on house tiles.

ceiling.how: VAMILY rule 451(a): the distribution center's roof joists and the cold rooms' panel ceilings, over the board at this alpha. 'src' is the picture COOK makes; 'have' true the day it is in the folder. Until then the fight draws 'kind' itself, a stand-in (the warehouse's roof).
